title: WEATHER FORECAST FOR 02 June 2026 Issued at 2.00 p.m. on 01 June 2026 Rainy conditions are expected to be enhance in the southwestern parts of the island from tomorrow (02 June) evening. Showers will occur at times in Western, Sabaragamuwa and North-western provinces and in Galle, Matara, Kandy and Nuwara-Eliya districts. Fairly heavy falls about 75 mm are likely at some places in these areas. Showers or thundershowers may occur at a few places in Uva province and in Ampara and Batticaloa districts after 1.00 pm. Fairly strong winds about (30-40) kmph can be expected at times over Western slopes of the central hills, Northern, North-central, North-western and Southern provinces and in Trincomalee district. The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damage caused by temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers.
